metadata.description: Stack-first skills library covering QA, frontend, backend, data, and business-analysis: install one self-contained plugin per tech stack. `qa-{java,dotnet,typescript}` bundle every QA discipline — API/UI/mobile/performance/LLM/BDD authoring and verification, manual-QA process, CI/CD, reporting, and OWASP-mapped security. `fe-{blazor,react}` are phased frontend dev-stack agents (scaffold → architecture → features → quality → tests → review). `be-{dotnet,java,node}` are phased backend dev-stack agents for design-pattern application, ORM persistence, and Auth0/Cognito service-side auth. `devops` ships the platform lane — container images, IaC, cloud deploys, and build/deploy pipelines. `data` and `business-analysis` round out the database-engineering and cross-feature requirements domains.

plugins.name: qa-java
plugins.description: Self-contained senior automation-QA plugin for Java 21 (RestAssured + TestNG, Selenium/Playwright/Appium, Gatling, Cucumber-JVM). Covers every discipline end-to-end: API/UI/mobile/performance/LLM test authoring and review, BDD living documentation, deep verification (DB, messaging, email, files, websockets), Pact contracts, chaos and feature-flag testing. Bundles the language-agnostic manual-QA process skills, CI/CD pipeline skills, test reporting (Allure + flaky-test quarantine), and the cross-stack OWASP-mapped security skills and qa-security agent — install just this one plugin for a complete Java QA toolkit.

plugins.name: qa-dotnet
plugins.description: Self-contained senior automation-QA plugin for .NET 10 / C#, 8-9 supported and version-aware (NUnit + RestSharp, Playwright/Selenium/Appium, NBomber, Reqnroll). Covers every discipline end-to-end: project scaffolding from zero (API/UI/mobile/performance/BDD), API/UI/mobile/performance/LLM test authoring and review, BDD living documentation, deep verification (DB, messaging, email, files, websockets), Pact contracts, chaos and feature-flag testing, mutation testing (Stryker.NET). Bundles the language-agnostic manual-QA process skills, CI/CD pipeline skills, test reporting (Allure + flaky-test quarantine), and the cross-stack OWASP-mapped security skills and qa-security agent, plus a one-call read-only conformance audit (/qa-dotnet-audit) that sweeps an existing test suite against every convention above into a saved, re-runnable findings report — install just this one plugin for a complete .NET QA toolkit.

plugins.name: qa-typescript
plugins.description: Self-contained senior automation-QA plugin for TypeScript (Vitest + fetch + Zod, Playwright/Appium, k6, playwright-bdd / CucumberJS). Covers every discipline end-to-end: API/UI/mobile/performance/LLM test authoring and review, BDD living documentation, deep verification (DB, messaging, email, files, websockets), Pact contracts, chaos and feature-flag testing. Bundles the language-agnostic manual-QA process skills, CI/CD pipeline skills, test reporting (Allure + flaky-test quarantine), and the cross-stack OWASP-mapped security skills and qa-security agent — install just this one plugin for a complete TypeScript QA toolkit.

plugins.name: fe-blazor
plugins.description: Self-contained senior frontend Blazor developer plugin for .NET 8/9/10 (Blazor Web App, unified render modes). Covers the full FE build lifecycle end-to-end: project scaffold and render-mode strategy, architecture foundations (state, component library, styling, responsive design), feature build (pages/components/forms, API + live/realtime data, motion, UX writing, data-testids), quality layers (accessibility, performance, error resilience, SEO), and dev-side tests at both altitudes (bUnit v2 for components, plain NUnit/xUnit for state containers, validators and formatters) — plus a distinctive-visual-design critique loop. Bundles the Auth0 Blazor auth skills and the stack-agnostic design-craft skills (frontend-design, design-tokens, dataviz, brand-intake, iconography, ux-heuristics, theme-factory, ux-writing, web-design-guidelines) and the phased fe-blazor orchestrator agent — install just this one plugin for a complete Blazor frontend toolkit.

plugins.name: data
plugins.description: Self-contained senior data / database engineer plugin across 8 engines — PostgreSQL, SQL Server / Azure SQL, MySQL / MariaDB / Aurora, MongoDB, Redis / Valkey, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB, Elasticsearch / OpenSearch. Covers the full data lifecycle end-to-end: engine selection and version detection, schema / document / container modeling, security (roles / RLS / encryption / fine-grained IAM / DLS-FLS / audit), safe expand-contract online migrations, indexing, and query tuning — from a .NET 10 / Java 21 / Node 24 backend. Each engine skill is version-aware; the four cross-engine _shared skills (schema-design, migrations, caching-patterns, query-optimization) own the cross-engine decisions while the engine skills own the mechanics. Bundles the phased data-architect orchestrator agent — install just this one plugin for a complete database-engineering toolkit.

plugins.name: business-analysis
plugins.description: Self-contained senior business-analysis plugin covering the whole upstream requirements lifecycle in two lanes. The AUTHORING lane turns a vague stakeholder ask into refinement-ready artifacts: a single-initiative scoping writeup, outcome-shaped epics, INVEST user stories with Gherkin acceptance criteria, and a review-only backlog readiness audit for stories authored elsewhere. It additionally bundles the be-documenter agent (/be-documenter), which reverse-engineers business documentation from an existing backend implementation into the same knowledge base — areas, actors, use cases and rules recovered from code, every statement tiered #observed/#inferred and never #confirmed. The REASONING lane checks features against the WHOLE project: a persistent per-project business-model knowledge base (docs/business-model/ — read-first / update-after, stable IDs, source traceability), BPMN-disciplined Mermaid flow mapping, one state × event lifecycle grid per business entity with all features overlaid, merged DMN-style decision tables with declared hit policies and mechanical completeness/overlap checks, and the taxonomy-driven feature-conflict sweep (11 conflict classes, mandatory boundary conditions, severity-tabled findings, resolutions recorded as business decisions). Sits upstream of QA test design — its artifacts and boundary conditions are first-class test-basis inputs. Bundles two phased orchestrator agents: requirements-author (scope → epics → stories → audit) and business-analyst (analyze / model / audit modes) — install just this one plugin for a complete business-analysis toolkit.

plugins.name: fe-react
plugins.description: Self-contained senior frontend React developer plugin for React 19/18 + TypeScript (Next.js App Router / RSC primary, Vite SPA fallback; MUI default). Covers the full FE build lifecycle end-to-end: project scaffold and rendering-strategy choice, architecture foundations (RSC/'use client' boundary, App Router route topology, state, component library, styling, responsive design), feature build (pages/components/forms with React Hook Form + Zod, API + live/realtime data via RSC fetch/Server Actions/TanStack Query/SSE/WebSocket, motion, UX writing, data-testids), quality layers (accessibility, performance, error resilience, SEO, i18n, PWA/offline), and dev-side tests at both altitudes (Vitest + React Testing Library for components and hooks, plain Vitest for Zod schemas, formatters, stores and extracted async-RSC fetches) — plus version migration (React 18→19, Next 14→15, Pages→App Router), a distinctive-visual-design critique loop, and a one-call read-only conformance audit (/fe-react-audit) that sweeps an existing codebase against every convention above into a saved, re-runnable findings report. Bundles the Auth0 React auth skills and the stack-agnostic design-craft skills (frontend-design, design-tokens, dataviz, brand-intake, iconography, ux-heuristics, theme-factory, ux-writing, web-design-guidelines) and the phased fe-react orchestrator agent — install just this one plugin for a complete React frontend toolkit.

plugins.name: be-dotnet
plugins.description: Self-contained senior .NET backend developer plugin (.NET 10 primary, 8/9 supported) for design-pattern application, EF Core persistence, and Auth0/Cognito service-side auth. Covers explaining patterns (Strategy, Decorator, Repository, CQRS/MediatR, Factory, Specification, Options, Pipeline, Saga, Outbox), scaffolding them into a codebase with constructor injection / async-all-the-way / nullable reference types, EF Core persistence (DbContext design, configurations, migrations, query patterns, optimistic concurrency, bulk operations), dev-side unit testing of that logic (NUnit 4 + NSubstitute + FakeTimeProvider, in-process only — no HTTP, no container, no real database), Auth0/Cognito JWT bearer validation + RBAC + Client Credentials M2M, and reviewing existing code for pattern misuse, DI/async violations, and layering bleeds — end-to-end or any single phase. Bundles the language-agnostic pattern reference/reviewer, the Auth0/Cognito concepts skills, the developer-workflow + read-only audit (ep-*) skills and the code-auditor agent, and the full observability toolkit (OpenTelemetry + Serilog structured logging + Loki/Tempo/Prometheus-Mimir backend + LogQL/PromQL + Grafana dashboards), plus the phased be-dotnet orchestrator and observability-engineer-dotnet agents and a one-call read-only conformance audit (/be-dotnet-audit) that sweeps an existing service against every convention above into a saved, re-runnable findings report — install just this one plugin for a complete .NET backend toolkit. Also bundles the stack-agnostic be-planner solution planner (/be-planner): it turns a business case or loose requirements into an approved high-level blueprint — functional areas, architecture, tech stack, and which library agent builds what — then a detailed plan pack (DB structure, service→resource→endpoint surface with request/response bodies, a shared validation and error catalog, an external-dependency register, and an ordered agent-bound task list with a plan+handoff loop), starting from scratch or picking up partially-built work. It also ships the be-documenter agent (/be-documenter) — the reverse direction: it reads an existing backend, splits it into functional areas, confirms the split with you, then traces each area and writes what the system does from the END USER's perspective (capabilities, actors, use cases, business rules, failure behaviour) into the docs/business-model/ knowledge base, modelled with flowcharts, decision tables and state grids — tiering every statement as #observed (what the code does, with file:line) or #inferred (what it is probably for, which becomes a question for the business), and never inventing intent.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Self-contained senior DevOps / platform engineer plugin — the path from a built service to a running one: production-shaped container images (multi-stage, pinned, non-root, healthchecked), Infrastructure as Code (Bicep for Azure, Terraform for AWS/multi-cloud), cloud deploy primitives (AWS ECS Fargate / Lambda / App Runner / S3+CloudFront / EKS and Azure Container Apps / Functions / App Service / Static Web Apps / AKS), Kubernetes manifests and Helm/Kustomize, build-and-deploy pipelines on GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Azure Pipelines, and per-environment configuration and secrets. Cloud-keyed rather than stack-triplicated, and version-aware across .NET 10 (8/9 supported) / Java 21 / Node 24 (22 maintenance). OIDC and Workload Identity Federation throughout — no static cloud credentials anywhere. Bundles two phased orchestrator agents — devops-engineer (build) and devops-auditor (read-only conformance audit of an existing setup, saved to docs/audits/), both of which inspect the repo and confirm the tool stack with you before loading a single skill — plus the ep-* developer-workflow skills and the code-auditor agent — install just this one plugin for a complete deploy toolkit.
